resources.string: Slides into a small tab when not in use
Removed 30 s after the game starts (then Back opens these settings)
* Applies the next time the game starts.
A controller is connected, so touch controls hide on their own. Tick this to use both.
Size of the touch controls and the CTRL button: %1$d%%
Opacity of the touch controls and the CTRL button: %1$d%%
Drag on the screen to move the camera
Touch the right part of the screen away from the buttons and drag. The right stick stays; hide it with Edit touch controls layout if you like.
Which game button each button of your controller presses. Applied at once; the touch controls keep their buttons.
Smoother 60 uses the 120 Hz screen mode: a late frame shows after 25 ms instead of 33 ms.
Use the recommended resolution and frame rate
Recommended values selected: press Apply to keep them.
Sharp textures at an angle (4x anisotropic filtering) *
Off: floors and walls seen at an angle look softer, with less GPU work on texture-heavy GPUs (Mali).
Shows more to the sides on screens wider than 16:9; menus and HUD stay 16:9. At 1080p and 1440p it needs a fast GPU.
Background blur. Off is sharper and faster.
Smoother in busy scenes, a little more power.
Frame rate and frame times. May cause performance issues.
Records statistics for bug reports. Slight extra load.

This saves the game logs in your Download folder and opens a GitHub issue form with the game version, your phone, GPU and settings filled in. Describe the problem there and attach the logs file. You need a GitHub account; the game keeps running in the background.
Debug logging is off, so the logs say little. For a better report, turn it on, restart the game, make the problem happen, then report it.
Debug logging is on from the next start. Restart the game, make the problem happen, then report it.
Logs saved in Download as %1$s. Attach that file to the issue.
No web browser found. Open %1$s on another device and attach %2$s.
The frame capture was too big for GitHub and was left out.
Attach %1$s (the logs file the game just saved) here:
Save logs for a bug report …
Logs saved as %1$s. Attach that file to your bug report.
This device has no file picker to save the logs with.
Progress since the game last saved is lost. To be safe, choose Quit Game in the game\'s System menu first (it saves and returns to the title screen), then exit here.
Settings marked * apply when the game starts. Restarting now loses progress since the last save.
For phones whose picture is wrong or black (for example the Adreno 600 series). Try one option at a time, then combinations. Each applies at the next start.
The faster paths for copies between render targets and textures.
Only render target transfer shortcuts off *
Part of the option above, to find which shortcut causes a problem.
Part of the resolve shortcuts, to find which one causes a problem.
Builds each GPU pipeline in one piece (slower to start a new effect).
Classic Vulkan render passes. Already used with Arm\'s own Mali driver.
Automatic (direct to memory on this GPU)
Turnip image compression off * (Turnip drivers only)
Keeps the lit 3D scene in a 32-bit image instead of 64-bit (Adreno 6xx test: wrong colours and black bands in gameplay).
Plainer translated shaders: texture fetches and branches as the console does them.
Capture one frame for a bug report

Saves the images the GPU draws for one gameplay frame into the logs (about 100–200 MB on the phone, replaced by the next capture). Close this menu and stand in the game; then use Save logs for a bug report. The game pauses for a moment while it saves.
One frame is captured %1$d seconds from now. Then use CTRL → Save logs.
The game\'s compressed (BC / DXT) textures are unpacked before use instead of read by the GPU directly. Uses more memory.
Less memory traffic for every vertex drawn. Textures may look a little softer or shimmer.
Mali test: buffer range checks off *
Skips the safety checks the driver does on buffer reads. Possibly faster; the game may crash.
Turnip: keep its reserved descriptor set * (Turnip drivers only)

resources.string: Hide them on the main screen
HP, stamina, the item slots, effect icons and souls show on the second screen only. Status build-up, boss and enemy bars and messages stay.

Copies of your save in a folder you choose, outside the app, so uninstalling the game does not delete them. A copy is made when the game has saved, at most every 10 minutes. The latest 10 and one for each of the last 7 days played are kept, up to 64 MB in all (the latest 3 always).
Choose or create a folder, for example Documents/DS2 saves.
The app can no longer open this folder. Choose it again.
No backups in this folder yet.
The game has no save yet.
This device has no folder picker.
Save backups are off. The backups stay in the folder.
Nothing to back up: the game has no save yet.
The game was saving. Try again in a moment.
The game restarts and loads the backup from %1$s. Your current save is moved aside, not deleted. Progress since the last save is lost.
The backup replaces your save the next time the game starts.
A backup replaces your save the next time the game starts.
The newest is from %1$s. Restore it?
The newest is from %1$s. Restore it? If not, your current save stays as it is and is backed up here too.
Save restored from the backup of %1$s.
The save backup could not be restored (details in the log).
